2608.28011.title: Coverage, Not Credit: Failure-Credit Routing of Zeroth-Order Perturbation Budgets Does Not Improve On-Pool Sample Efficiency for LLM Agents
2608.28011.paper_summary: Trajectory-level credit assignment can localize which module of a tool-using LLM agent causes failures using only verifiable signals. We ask whether such failure credit should route a fixed zeroth-order/evolution-strategies (ZO/ES) perturbation budget. Across a synthetic environment and frozen Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B and SmolLM2-1.7B agents, three task families, six allocation schemes, a credit-noise sweep, paired seeds, and exact sign-flip tests, we find no statistically detectable improvement over uniform allocation in any on-pool comparison (no gain of at least 2 percentage points). The joint soft-plus-sigma scheme is equivalent to uniform within a +/- 0.02 AUC margin on 1.5B and 3B; concentrating the full budget on the credit argmax is marginally equivalent on 1.5B, where that module is the verified bottleneck, and significantly worse on 3B. Inverse-propensity debiasing does not rescue routing, and misrouting costs up to -0.074 AUC in-house and -0.118 end-to-end on the BFCL-derived family. Across six fixed-step schedules, loss is linear in bottleneck starvation rate (R^2 = 0.94, descriptive), and a preregistered credit-free coverage floor removes detected harm. Matched-budget burst and step-compensating catch-up schedules are consistent with harm arising from insufficient cumulative parameter movement rather than update frequency. Our primary estimand is optimization efficiency on a fixed task pool. On unseen BFCL functions, the study's one exception is that soft routing exceeds uniform on held-out endpoints (+0.047, p = 0.031, n = 6). A plausible but untested reading is that routing-favored caller improvements transfer while uniform's on-pool gains reflect a synthesizer behavior specific to our harness. We report this exception explicitly and document three failure modes that can silently invalidate ZO/ES experiments on frozen LLMs.
2608.28011.paper_summary_zh: 軌跡級的信用分配可以僅使用可驗證的信號來定位工具使用 LLM 代理的哪個模塊導致失敗。我們詢問這種失敗的信用是否應該路由固定的零階/進化策略 (ZO/ES) 擾動預算。在一個合成環境中，以及凍結的 Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B 和 SmolLM2-1.7B 代理中，三個任務系列、六種分配方案、一個信用噪聲掃描、配對種子和精確的符號翻轉測試，我們發現在任何池內比較中，對均勻分配沒有統計上可檢測的改進（至少沒有增加 2 個百分點）。聯合 soft-plus-sigma 方案在 1.5B 和 3B 上在 +/- 0.02 AUC 的範圍內等同於均勻；將全部預算集中在信用 argmax 上在 1.5B 上邊際等同，因為該模塊是經過驗證的瓶頸，而在 3B 上則顯著更差。逆傾向去偏差並未挽救路由，錯誤路由在內部成本高達 -0.074 AUC，並在 BFCL 衍生的系列中端到端成本為 -0.118。在六個固定步驟計畫中，損失與瓶頸飢餓率成線性關係 (R^2 = 0.94，描述性)，並且預註冊的無信用覆蓋底線消除了檢測到的傷害。匹配預算的突發和步驟補償追趕計畫與由於累積參數移動不足而產生的傷害是一致的，而不是更新頻率。我們的主要估計量是固定任務池上的優化效率。在未見的 BFCL 函數上，這項研究的唯一例外是，soft routing 在保留的端點上超過均勻 (+0.047，p = 0.031，n = 6)。一種合理但未經測試的解讀是，路由偏好的呼叫者改進會轉移，而均勻的池內增益反映了我們的裝置特有的合成器行為。我們明確報告這一例外並記錄三種失敗模式，這些模式可能會無聲地使凍結的 LLM 上的 ZO/ES 實驗失效。
